value.text:
I am identifying which memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks.

Four memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks: created, updated, deleted, and comment created. Their dispatch functions are DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook, DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook, DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook, and DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook. All converge at webhook.PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go, which then calls webhook.Post for actual delivery.

The created, updated, and deleted webhooks route through an intermediate function called `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`. The comment-created webhook bypasses that helper and calls `PostAsync` directly.

The fileserver's current `getUserByIdentifier` behavior shows both lookup styles exist today, but the API-layer contract for this issue becomes username-only rather than dual-mode.
/bench/repo/docs/plans/2026-03-24-user-resource-identifiers/design.md:55:Keep child resource tokens unchanged and only change the user segment. For names such as `users/{user}/settings/{setting}`, `users/{user}/webhooks/{webhook}`, `users/{user}/notifications/{notification}`, `users/{user}/shortcuts/{shortcut}`, and `users/{user}/personalAccessTokens/{token}`, the parent `user` token is resolved from the username, while the child token keeps its existing format and storage mapping. This is narrower than redesigning child identifiers and keeps the issue bounded to the user-resource segment.

value.text:
The answer is fully determined. Four memo lifecycle events and their dispatch functions are defined in `memo_service_webhooks.go`.

All four dispatch functions enqueue via `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. Workers then call `Post` for actual HTTP delivery.

DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook, DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook, DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook, and DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook are the four dispatch functions. They are defined in `memo_service_webhooks.go`.

memosmemo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memos.memo.comment.created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
webhook.PostAsync (internal/webhook/webhook.go)
